source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Βασίλειος ο Νέος»

attestations.note: The page gives three facts and no more: that he was the brother of the venerable Paul «ἐν τῷ Λάτρῳ», whose memory it puts on 15 December; that he practised ascesis on Mount Latros; and that he fell asleep in peace «το έτος 944 ή 952 μ.Χ.», in 944 or 952. It prints no hymn. The Greek calendar also keeps a Basil the New at Constantinople, and this page's Basil the New is identified only by Latros and by his brother.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 944 ή 952 μ.Χ.» The page offers the two years and does not choose between them, so the interval keeps both.
